newsitem.title: USA: ALPINE SKIING-RIEGLER FASTEST IN FIRST RUN OF WOMEN'S SLALOM. [CORRECTED 10:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-RIEGLER FASTEST IN FIRST RUN OF WOMEN'S SLALOM. [CORRECTED 10:05 GMT]

text.p: Claudia Riegler of New Zealand posted the fastest time on the first run of a wome's slalom Saturday.

Racing on a course manicured carefully after a day-long rainstorm forced cancellation of a race the previous day, Riegler was timed in 49.90 seconds for a comfortable margin over Pernilla Wiberg of Sweden, timed in 50:39.

Deborah Compagnoni of Italy, better known for her giant slalom, came from the 18th start position to claim fourth in 51:08. Sabina Egger of Austria, starting 29th, tied Ingrid Salvenmoser of Austria for fifth at 51.42.
Martina Accola of Switzerland and Spela Pretnar of Slovenia were among those who failed to finish a course that became choppy with loose snow (Corrects to reflect suprise showings by late starters.)
